resources.string: Marka hore waxaan ku weydiin doonaa saddex ogolaansho: makarafoonka, kamarada iyo ogeysiisyada. Daaqad kasta, dooro Oggolow.

Tallaabada xigta. Taabo badhanka hoose. Liiska ka raadi SENTIA badhamada codka, shid oo xaqiiji. Haddii taleefanku diido, fur macluumaadka app-ka SENTIA, taabo saddexda dhibcood ee midig sare, dooro Oggolow goobaha xaddidan, kadibna mar kale isku day. Markaas halkan ku soo noqo.
Wali lama shidin. Taabo badhanka, raadi SENTIA badhamada codka, oo shid. Ama dooro Dabadeed.
Waa diyaar. Si aad ii dejiso, saddex jeer si degdeg ah u riix Codka kor, ama gilgil taleefanka.

Tallaabada xigta. Taabo badhanka hoose. Liiska ka taabo SENTIA, kadibna shid Muuji kaga sarreeya abaabulada kale. Tani waxay u ogolaataa SENTIA inay is furto marka aad toosiso. Markaas halkan ku soo noqo.
Wali lama shidin. Taabo badhanka, taabo SENTIA oo shid furaha. Ama dooro Dabadeed.
Tallaabadii ugu dambaysay. Taabo badhanka, kadibna dooro Oggolow. Tani waxay ka hortagtaa in taleefanku SENTIA seexiyo. Markaas halkan ku soo noqo.
Wali lama oggolaan. Taabo badhanka, kadibna dooro Oggolow. Ama dooro Dabadeed.
